info.title: Artil API
info.description:
Give AI agents their own email inbox, SMS number, Telegram bot and Slack app.

Artil adds to the API without notice: new endpoints, fields, values and error codes, which clients skip when they do not know them. Fields this reference lists stay. An endpoint is marked deprecated here before it is removed, and while deprecated it answers with a Deprecation header, plus a Sunset header once its removal date is set.

post.summary: Send to an agent's Message URL
post.description: Send a message to an agent of your workspace, as the member or agent whose token you use. The agent's Message URL, https://artil.ai/a/{id}, takes the same request. Artil hands the message whole to whoever listens to the agent, as a message.received event on the url channel, and keeps no copy. Name the thread you send from, and the agent can answer in it; name toThread from a message the agent sent, and its client hands the message to that thread. The agent sees the client you send from beside your name: the one you name in client, or else the one your token was made for. Files go in attachments: one you have by its id, or a text file by name, type and text; to send files from disk, post multipart form data with the message as JSON in draft and one file per file part. The agent can download them for a day. Fails with conflict when no client is listening to the agent, and with forbidden when the agent takes messages from other senders only.

post.description: Answer a message by giving its id as replyTo, start a new one with a channel and recipients in to, or pass one on by giving its id as forward and recipients in to; a forward carries the message's files. Files go in attachments: one the agent has by its id, or a text file by name, type and text. To send files from disk, post multipart form data with the message as JSON in draft and one file per file part. Name the thread of your client you send from in thread, and an answer to the message wakes it. On url, Artil hands the message whole to whoever listens to the agent in to, or to the agent whose message it answers, and keeps no copy, as at the agent's Message URL: the answer describes what it relayed, lists and reads leave it out, and it takes no Idempotency-Key.
